reason.zh: llama.cpp 总是按 GGUF 加载，这个选项从未传给引擎。
reason.en: llama.cpp always loads GGUF; this option never reached the engine.

summary.zh: 每个并发槽位可用的 token 数；实际 --ctx-size 是它乘以最大并发请求。
summary.en: The tokens each concurrent slot may use; the actual --ctx-size is this times Max concurrent requests.

what.zh: llama.cpp 把总上下文（--ctx-size）平均分给各个并发槽位，平台按每个槽位的长度乘以并发数来设置总量。
what.en: llama.cpp divides the total context (--ctx-size) evenly between its concurrent slots, so the platform sets the total to the per-slot length times the concurrency.

what.zh: 对应 --parallel：同时服务的槽位数，KV 缓存按槽位平分。
what.en: Maps to --parallel: the number of slots served at once; the KV cache is shared out per slot.

summary.zh: 规划显存和多卡切分时按这个比例估算可用显存；llama.cpp 本身不会预留固定比例。
summary.en: The share of GPU memory assumed usable when planning memory and multi-GPU splits; llama.cpp itself reserves no fixed fraction.

what.zh: 只用于平台的显存规划和切分比例建议，不会作为参数传给 llama-server。
what.en: Only used by the platform's memory planning and split suggestions; it is not passed to llama-server.

whenToChange.zh: 同一张卡还要运行其它程序时调小，让规划留出更多余量。
whenToChange.en: Lower it when other programs share the GPU, so planning leaves more room.

tradeoffs.zh: 过高的估计可能让实际启动时显存不足。
tradeoffs.en: An optimistic value can leave too little memory at the real start.

summary.zh: 放到显卡上的模型层数；其余层留在系统内存，由 CPU 计算。
summary.en: How many model layers go on the GPU; the rest stay in system RAM and run on the CPU.

what.zh: 对应 --n-gpu-layers。all 表示全部层；auto 会让 llama.cpp 按显存自动适配（--fit on）；也可以填写具体层数。
what.en: Maps to --n-gpu-layers. all puts every layer on the GPU; auto lets llama.cpp fit the layers to memory (--fit on); a number also works.

whenToChange.zh: 模型放不进显存时减少层数或选 auto。
whenToChange.en: Lower the count or choose auto when the model does not fit in GPU memory.

tradeoffs.zh: 留在 CPU 上的层越多，生成越慢。
tradeoffs.en: The more layers stay on the CPU, the slower generation gets.

summary.zh: 自动适配显存时，每张卡预留的空闲显存。
summary.en: The free memory each GPU keeps when layers are fitted automatically.

what.zh: 对应 --fit on --fit-target。GPU 层数为 auto 时默认 1024 MiB。
what.en: Maps to --fit on --fit-target. With Layers on GPU set to auto the default is 1024 MiB.

whenToChange.zh: 自动适配后仍然显存不足时调大。
whenToChange.en: Raise it when memory still runs out after fitting.

tradeoffs.zh: 余量越大，放到显卡上的层越少。
tradeoffs.en: More headroom puts fewer layers on the GPU.

summary.zh: 自动适配显存时按多长的上下文预留 KV 缓存。
summary.en: The context length whose KV cache is reserved when layers are fitted automatically.

what.zh: 对应 --fit-ctx。GPU 层数为 auto 时默认等于每请求上下文长度。
what.en: Maps to --fit-ctx. With Layers on GPU set to auto it defaults to the per-request context length.

whenToChange.zh: 实际使用的上下文远小于设置值、想多放几层到显卡时调小。
whenToChange.en: Lower it when real prompts are much shorter than the setting and you want more layers on the GPU.

tradeoffs.zh: 设得过小，长请求可能在运行中显存不足。
tradeoffs.en: Too small, and long requests may run out of memory mid-way.

summary.zh: 一次提交处理的最大 token 数。
summary.en: The most tokens submitted for processing at once.

what.zh: 对应 --batch-size，主要影响预填充速度。
what.en: Maps to --batch-size and mainly affects prefill speed.

whenToChange.zh: 长提示词预填充慢、显存又有余量时调大。
whenToChange.en: Raise it when long prompts prefill slowly and memory allows.

tradeoffs.zh: 越大占用的计算缓冲越多。
tradeoffs.en: Larger values need bigger compute buffers.

summary.zh: 每次实际送进 GPU 计算的 token 数，不能大于逻辑批大小。
summary.en: How many tokens actually go to the GPU per step; it cannot exceed the logical batch.

what.zh: 对应 --ubatch-size。
what.en: Maps to --ubatch-size.

whenToChange.zh: 预填充时显存峰值过高就调小；显存充足时调大能加快预填充。
whenToChange.en: Lower it when prefill peaks too high in memory; raise it to prefill faster when memory is plentiful.

tradeoffs.zh: 越大计算缓冲越占显存。
tradeoffs.en: Larger values make the compute buffers use more memory.

summary.zh: KV 缓存中键（K）的数据类型；量化类型更省显存。
summary.en: The data type of the keys (K) in the KV cache; quantized types save memory.

what.zh: 对应 --cache-type-k。f16 为默认；q8_0 约省一半，q4_0 约省四分之三。
what.en: Maps to --cache-type-k. f16 is the default; q8_0 saves about half, q4_0 about three quarters.

whenToChange.zh: 需要更长上下文、显存不够时选 q8_0 或更低。
whenToChange.en: Choose q8_0 or lower when you need longer context than memory allows.

tradeoffs.zh: 精度越低，长上下文质量下降越明显。
tradeoffs.en: Lower precision reduces long-context quality more noticeably.

summary.zh: KV 缓存中值（V）的数据类型；量化类型需要开启 Flash Attention。
summary.en: The data type of the values (V) in the KV cache; quantized types need Flash Attention.

what.zh: 对应 --cache-type-v。量化的 V 缓存（q8_0、q5_1、q4_0 等）只能在 Flash Attention 为 on 或 auto 时使用。
what.en: Maps to --cache-type-v. A quantized V cache (q8_0, q5_1, q4_0 and so on) only works with Flash Attention on or auto.

whenToChange.zh: 需要更长上下文、显存不够时选 q8_0 或更低。
whenToChange.en: Choose q8_0 or lower when you need longer context than memory allows.

tradeoffs.zh: 精度越低，长上下文质量下降越明显。
tradeoffs.en: Lower precision reduces long-context quality more noticeably.

summary.zh: 使用 Flash Attention 计算注意力，更快更省显存。
summary.en: Computes attention with Flash Attention, which is faster and uses less memory.

what.zh: 对应 --flash-attn。auto 由 llama.cpp 判断当前显卡和模型是否支持。
what.en: Maps to --flash-attn. auto lets llama.cpp decide whether this GPU and model support it.

whenToChange.zh: 排查输出异常时可以设为 off 对比。
whenToChange.en: Set it to off to compare when investigating bad output.

tradeoffs.zh: 设为 off 时不能使用量化的 V 缓存。
tradeoffs.en: With off, a quantized V cache cannot be used.

summary.zh: 提示词中间有改动时，按这个大小的块平移复用已缓存的 KV。
summary.en: When a prompt changes in the middle, cached KV is shifted and reused in chunks of this size.

what.zh: 对应 --cache-reuse，平台默认 512；0 表示关闭。
what.en: Maps to --cache-reuse; the platform default is 512 and 0 turns it off.

whenToChange.zh: 客户端经常改动对话中间的内容（例如压缩历史）时保持开启；排查缓存问题时设为 0。
whenToChange.en: Keep it on when clients often edit the middle of a conversation (history compression, for example); use 0 when investigating cache problems.

tradeoffs.zh: 块越小复用越多，但匹配开销越大。
tradeoffs.en: Smaller chunks reuse more but cost more matching work.

summary.zh: 模型如何分布到多张 GPU 上。
summary.en: How the model is spread over several GPUs.

what.zh: 对应 --split-mode。layer 按层分配，适合不同型号的显卡混用；row 按行切分每一层；none 只用一张卡。
what.en: Maps to --split-mode. layer assigns whole layers and suits mixed GPU models; row splits each layer by rows; none uses one GPU.

whenToChange.zh: 多卡运行时按显卡互联和型号选择；只选了一张卡时自动为 none。
whenToChange.en: Pick by GPU links and models when running on several GPUs; with one GPU selected it is none automatically.

tradeoffs.zh: row 需要更多卡间通信，在 PCIe 上往往比 layer 慢。
tradeoffs.en: row needs more GPU-to-GPU traffic and is often slower than layer over PCIe.

summary.zh: 各张 GPU 分到的模型比例，例如 24,8。留空按推荐方案自动计算。
summary.en: The share of the model each GPU gets, for example 24,8. Empty computes the recommended split.

what.zh: 对应 --tensor-split，按所选 GPU 的顺序填写。
what.en: Maps to --tensor-split, listed in the order of the selected GPUs.

whenToChange.zh: 显卡显存大小不同、自动比例不理想时。
whenToChange.en: When the GPUs have different memory sizes and the automatic split is poor.

tradeoffs.zh: 比例不合理会让某张卡先耗尽显存。
tradeoffs.en: A poor split runs one GPU out of memory first.

summary.zh: 放置中间结果和单卡计算的 GPU，按所选 GPU 内的序号计。
summary.en: The GPU that holds intermediate results and single-GPU work, counted within the selected GPUs.

what.zh: 对应 --main-gpu。
what.en: Maps to --main-gpu.

whenToChange.zh: 希望由显存最大或最快的那张卡承担主计算时。
whenToChange.en: When the GPU with the most memory or the fastest GPU should do the main work.

tradeoffs.zh: 主卡需要额外的显存余量。
tradeoffs.en: The main GPU needs some extra memory headroom.

summary.zh: 不使用内存映射，启动时把模型完整读入内存。
summary.en: Reads the whole model into memory at start instead of memory-mapping it.

what.zh: 对应 --no-mmap。
what.en: Maps to --no-mmap.

whenToChange.zh: 模型在网络盘或 WSL 挂载目录上，mmap 读取很慢时。
whenToChange.en: When the model sits on a network drive or a WSL-mounted folder and mmap reads are slow.

tradeoffs.zh: 启动时占用更多系统内存。
tradeoffs.en: Uses more system RAM at start.

summary.zh: 不为 CPU 计算重新排列权重布局。
summary.en: Skips rearranging weights for CPU computation.

what.zh: 对应 --no-repack。
what.en: Maps to --no-repack.

whenToChange.zh: 重排导致内存占用翻倍或启动过慢时。
whenToChange.en: When repacking doubles memory use or slows the start too much.

tradeoffs.zh: 留在 CPU 上的层计算会变慢。
tradeoffs.en: Layers that stay on the CPU compute more slowly.

summary.zh: 是否让支持思考的模型先思考再回答。
summary.en: Whether models that can reason think before answering.

what.zh: 对应 --reasoning。auto 按模型的聊天模板决定。
what.en: Maps to --reasoning. auto follows the model's chat template.

whenToChange.zh: 希望强制开启或关闭思考时。
whenToChange.en: To force thinking on or off.

tradeoffs.zh: 思考会增加输出 token 和等待时间。
tradeoffs.en: Thinking adds output tokens and waiting time.

summary.zh: 思考内容放在哪里返回给客户端。
summary.en: Where the thinking is returned to the client.

what.zh: 对应 --reasoning-format。deepseek 放进 reasoning_content；deepseek-legacy 同时保留 <think> 标签；none 原样输出。
what.en: Maps to --reasoning-format. deepseek returns it as reasoning_content; deepseek-legacy also keeps the <think> tags; none returns the raw text.

whenToChange.zh: 客户端看不到思考内容，或思考标签混在回答里时。
whenToChange.en: When clients cannot see the thinking, or thinking tags are mixed into the answer.

tradeoffs.zh: 客户端必须支持所选格式才能正确显示。
tradeoffs.en: Clients must support the chosen format to show it properly.

summary.zh: 支持强度控制的模型默认思考多深。
summary.en: How deeply models with effort control think by default.

what.zh: 对应 --reasoning-effort，需要运行时支持。default 使用模板默认值。
what.en: Maps to --reasoning-effort and needs runtime support. default keeps the template's value.

whenToChange.zh: 希望默认回答更快（调低）或更深入（调高）时。
whenToChange.en: To answer faster by default (lower) or more thoroughly (higher).

tradeoffs.zh: 强度越高输出 token 越多、等待越久。
tradeoffs.en: Higher effort produces more tokens and longer waits.

summary.zh: 思考最多可用的 token 数；-1 表示不限制。
summary.en: The most tokens thinking may use; -1 means no limit.

what.zh: 对应 --reasoning-budget。0 表示禁止思考。
what.en: Maps to --reasoning-budget. 0 disables thinking.

whenToChange.zh: 思考过长、拖慢回答时设一个上限。
whenToChange.en: Set a cap when thinking runs long and slows answers down.

tradeoffs.zh: 上限过低可能影响复杂问题的回答质量。
tradeoffs.en: Too low a cap can hurt answers to hard questions.

summary.zh: 不加载视觉投影器（mmproj），只处理文本。
summary.en: Does not load the vision projector (mmproj) and handles text only.

what.zh: 开启时不传 --mmproj（远程仓库传 --no-mmproj）；关闭后会自动查找 mmproj*.gguf 或使用指定的投影器。
what.en: When on, --mmproj is left out (--no-mmproj for remote repositories); when off, mmproj*.gguf is found automatically or the given projector is used.

whenToChange.zh: 需要处理图片输入时关闭。
whenToChange.en: Turn it off to handle image inputs.

tradeoffs.zh: 关闭后投影器会额外占用显存。
tradeoffs.en: When off, the projector uses extra memory.

summary.zh: 多模态模型使用的投影器（mmproj）文件；留空时在模型目录里自动查找。
summary.en: The projector (mmproj) file for a multimodal model; empty finds one in the model folder.

what.zh: 对应 --mmproj。
what.en: Maps to --mmproj.

whenToChange.zh: 目录里有多个投影器，或投影器放在别处时。
whenToChange.en: When the folder has several projectors, or the projector lives elsewhere.

tradeoffs.zh: 投影器必须与模型配套，否则图片理解会出错。
tradeoffs.en: The projector must belong to the model, or image understanding goes wrong.

summary.zh: 投影器运行在哪个设备上：auto、none 或设备名。
summary.en: Which device runs the projector: auto, none or a device name.

what.zh: 对应 --mmproj-device，需要运行时支持。
what.en: Maps to --mmproj-device and needs runtime support.

whenToChange.zh: 想把投影器放到另一张卡或 CPU 上、给主模型腾出显存时。
whenToChange.en: To move the projector to another GPU or the CPU and free memory for the main model.

tradeoffs.zh: 放到 CPU 上处理图片会变慢。
tradeoffs.en: On the CPU, images are processed more slowly.
